jobs_results.title: Digital Analytics Consultant - Adobe Target
jobs_results.description:
What makes Cognizant Netcentric a great fit for you?

At Cognizant Netcentric, we come to work every day with the mission of leveraging cutting-edge technology to create memorable digital experiences for the worlds leading brands. And we do it as a diverse, global community of over 1500+ Adobe experts collaborating across countries, cultures, languages and technologies.

Were energized by an inclusive and responsive organizational culture that brings together the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the resources, growth opportunities and stability of a larger global organization. Holacracy is the cornerstone of how we work, empowering every individual with the power to make an impact within our organization. All this encourages us to learn and grow as individuals, and unite as a team to build innovative digital experiences that touch peoples lives.

Job Description

We are looking for a marketing technology professional with a very strong focus on digital analytics who loves to... transmit his/her passion for web technologies and big data projects to clients to shape and drive their digital solutions and experiences. You are a good fit if you are a sharp mind that gathers and analyses marketing & business needs and translates into efficient marketing platform solutions. Translating marketing planning and processes into workflows and required marketing tech stacks, especially covering Digital Analytics.

We are looking for professionals who help us build the future Customer Data Platforms and Data Driven Organizations. Analytics-, Customer Data- and Data Management Platforms is where your expertise lies. If you are looking for a role at the interface of Analytics and Marketing Technologies to effectively master all marketing touchpoints in order to drive Marketing Automation with regards to wider data solutions including Cloud Services, this position will suit you perfectly well.

Netcentric may probably feel like home for you, if you master one of the leading Analytics Solutions such as Google Analytics 360, Google Marketing Platform, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Tealium, Salesforce etc. and are eager and willing to expand your knowledge beyond them. Resting on your laurels is not familiar to you, nor is it for us.

In your day to day activities you will ...
• Consult and master projects with respect to tracking and measuring all desired on and offline touchpoints
• Advocate and consult customers through the creation of Analytics, Data Management and Customer Data Platform solutions
• Translate and define technical requirements for your internal colleagues and Technology Engineers to build and implement the desired solutions such as Tag Management Systems, Data Layers, Online & Offline Data Conjunction, Channel and Touchpoint Integrations, Implementation of various platforms and reporting solutions together with A/B Testings and high end personalization solutions
• Establish standard data privacy compliant processes for clients digital properties, to set up, maintain and track data for reach, performance, engagement and other behavior metrics
• Project manage account analytics efforts setting company-wide best practices and processes
• Manage Digital Analytics projects end to end from client handling, implementation, QA and support including trainings and ongoing customer support

Qualifications

What do we require?
• A proven record in managing analytics and data management projects
• Being able to develop strategies for data management solutions in digital marketing with a solid understanding of tracking omni-channel touchpoints
• Extensive hands-on experience with Adobe Target
• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Analytics / Digital Marketing tools and services with e.g. Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 360, Google Optimize, Google Cloud Products incl. BigQuery, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Adobe Audience Manager, Tealium, Pega, Salesforce, Data Studio, Tableau, Looker.
• Sound knowledge of CDP, DMP, DSP, Ad Serving landscape
• Ability to multi-task and perform effectively under pressure
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in the English language

What makes us smile when looking at your profile
• You are able to read/write basic HTML/HTML5 /CSS/JavaScript, other front end languages (Python, NodeJS, PHP, etc.), and ability to query large databases (SQL)
• Detailed experience in Online Marketing campaign and performance management
• Experience in tag architecture analysis and using tagging platform(s) to execute proper data flow
• Ability to explain architecture proposals to non-technical audiences and communicate business value of suggested ideas & plans
• Solid understanding of data privacy and data governance regulations such as GDPR

What do we offer YOU?
• Permanent contract
• 30 working days of vacation
• Flexible working hours
• Recognition bonus system
• Private health insurance
• Apple work equipment
• WFH equipment + welcome package
• WFH monthly expenses compensation
• Access to Udemy courses
• Adobe certification
• Sponsored gym membership
• Tax-free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarten and transport)
• A dynamic and international team
• Everyone has a voice; we are a Holacracy organisation

jobs_results.title: Consultant Credit Risk Modelling - Madrid
jobs_results.description:
Consultant Credit Risk Modelling - Madrid, Spain - J12764 - Competitive Salary (DOE)

An exciting opportunity to join an independent consulting firm specialising in finance, risk and strategy and with extensive global experience and industry recognition in the financial services. The role is to strengthen their consulting team with an entrepreneurial and dynamic leader to Manager a team. The opportunity will be to help shape a unique and professional environment with fantastic career opportunities.

Expertise required:-

Minimum of 5 years of experience in Credit risk Modelling (IRB) or banking and financial services industry

Ideally, knowledge of operational tasks in terms of validation of credit risk models and regulatory requirements related to IRB approach.

Knowledge of current regulatory requirements relating to ESG regulations and climate risk projects is an advantage.

Quantitative background with strong analytical skills and an interest in quantitative topics

Ability to... work with coding languages ie Excel, Python, SQL

Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team

Ability to work independently and to quickly familiarise with new topics, understand, structure and derive innovative solutions

Fluent in English and Spanish (incl. the ability to write professional reports) openess to travel in Europe

If this sounds like the role for you then please apply today!

Alternatively, you can refer a friend or colleague by taking part in our fantastic referral schemes! If you have a friend or colleague who would be interested in this role, please refer them to us. For each relevant candidate that you introduce to us (there is no limit) and we place, you will be entitled to our general gift/voucher scheme.

Datatech is one of the UK’s leading recruitment agencies in the field of analytics and host of the critically acclaimed event, Women in Data. For more information, visit our website: www.datatech.org.uk

jobs_results.title: SAP Consultant – SAP Business Analytics (Business Warehouse)
jobs_results.description:
Are you skilled in Data Analytics and eager to apply your expertise in SAP BW4? If you have a strong understanding of data modeling, extraction, and transformation, we have an exciting opportunity for you to shape our organization's data landscape. Join us and make a meaningful impact with your expertise. This full-time position in the region of Barcelona is ready to be filled immediately or as per mutual arrangement. Join us, contribute your expertise, and expect to drive efficiency and excellence at Siegfried.

Your role
• Requirements Engineering for Analytics together with the Business
• Architectural, functional, and technical support of the transition from BW 7.x to BW4 for the entire application landscape.
• Provide functional and technical support for SAP Analytics, project & line.
• Offer 2nd - 3rd level support of both stacks BW 7.x and BW4 as well as SAC- and FIORI applications (Embedded analytics).
• Take responsibility for the entire project cycle, including planning... conceptual design, implementation, validation, and go-live, in close cooperation with business departments.
• Management of external consultants, quality review (end-to-end implementation).
• Provide training and support to key users, assisting in issue resolution, and conducting workshops to promote effective utilization of SAP BW, SAC and embedded analytics.
• Closely collaborate with all business areas and interact with other Business Applications

Your profile
• Degree in Information Technology is a plus
• Several years of professional experience with Data Analytics, SAP BW (SAP BW 7.x, SAP BW/4, SAC, BEX 7.x, AFO)
• Several years of professional experience in configuration, modelling and maintenance in data warehouse systems and frontend technologies.
• Experience with SAP BW analytical authorization is a plus.
• Sound knowledge in requirements analysis availability to understand and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Ideally embedded analytics knowledge and professional experience working with standard S/4 data sources (2LIS*, CDS View based, FM,etc).
• Fluent in English, Spanish is a plus.
• Solution-oriented with strong communication skills.
• Resilient team player with high flexibility.

Working at Siegfried
• Two days of home office per week
• Free parking or shuttle bus from the city of Barcelona
• Subsidized canteen on-site or restaurant ticket: to use when eating out or working from home
• Medical, life, and accident insurance
• Access to "Club Siegfried": an exclusive platform with discounts and offers on over 400 services
• Contribution to nursery costs

Who we are

In the Midst of People’s Lives – Across the Globe

The Siegfried Group is one of the world’s leading Custom Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) developing and producing active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), intermediates and finished dosage forms. As our core competence, we successfully integrate chemical and pharmaceutical capabilities into a single business model.

The Siegfried name stands for highest quality, efficiency, flexibility and safety. Present in Europe, Asia and North America, we serve a broad global customer base from major international pharmaceutical companies down to small biologic-pharmaceutical organizations. For them we develop and produce product innovations on a large scale to finished products. We integrate our offer seamlessly into the customers’ value chain. Our comprehensive services range from early-stage Research & Development services such as synthesis, scale-up, formulation development, stability studies and method development all the way through to manufacturing services, ranging from preclinical R&D material for clinical trial purposes to commercial production.

We are able to produce about 200 of the approximately 1500 registered drug substances used in medicine. Moreover, we produce 20 percent of global demand for caffeine. Consequently, nearly 1 billion individuals come into contact with Siegfried products.

What we do in Barberà del Vallès

Bulk manufacturing and packaging of solid dosage forms for:
• oral applications incl. high potency (e.g. oncology)
• inhalation capsules for medical devices to treat respiratory diseases
